class Main {
public:
    void run() {
        int mod = 998244353;
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {

    vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));

        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(bReal, bImag, false);
        
        vector<double> resReal(n, 0.0), resImag(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> tmpReal(n, 0.0), tmpImag(n, 0.0);
        
        double factor = 0.25 / n;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            
            double ar1 = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai1 = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double ar2 = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai2 = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) * 0.5;
            
            double br1 = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi1 = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double br2 = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi2 = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * 0.5;
            
            resReal[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            resImag[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
            tmpReal[i] = ar1 * br2 - ai1 * bi2 + ar2 * br1 - ai2 * bi1;
            tmpImag[i] = ar1 * bi2 + ai1 * br2 + ar2 * bi1 + ai2 * br1;
        }

            result[i] = (int)((part1 + (part2 % mod << 15) + (part3 % mod << 30)) % mod);

    void performFFT(vector<double>& real, vector<double>& imag, bool inverse) {
        int n = real.size();
        int bits = 31 - __builtin_clz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> (32 - bits);
            if (i < j) {
                swap(real[i], real[j]);
                swap(imag[i], imag[j]);
            }

            vector<double> cosTable(half);
            vector<double> sinTable(half);
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {

                sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
            }

                    double ci = sinTable[j];
                    double ur = real[i + j];
                    double ui = imag[i + j];
                    double vr = real[i + j + half] * cr - imag[i + j + half] * ci;
                    double vi = real[i + j + half] * ci + imag[i + j + half] * cr;
                    
                    real[i + j] = ur + vr;
                    imag[i + j] = ui + vi;
                    real[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                    imag[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                real[i] /= n;
                imag[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};
